rationale: C20 plausibly supplied a material drafting template for the child. It identifies a specific water-development proposal as raising unresolved national-policy questions, warns that project-specific action could establish problematic precedents, calls for careful study within the Executive Branch, and promises considered recommendations to Congress. The child expands that same logic into a general diagnosis that piecemeal water-policy decisions have created inconsistencies, followed by creation of a commission to study national water-resource policy and recommend legislation. C02 has a similar assignment-and-recommendations structure, while C11 provides more general review machinery, but neither matches the child's substantive policy logic as closely as C20.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Frequently, new policies which have been developed to meet specific situations or to solve particular social and economic needs existing at the time have produced inconsistencies in our national water resources policies.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Therefore the policies established in connection with this project will be extremely important. They will be precedents for other water supply projects which may be constructed in the future in other States where present legislation has not been applied.
shared_material.explanation: Both frame case-specific water-development decisions as capable of producing broader and potentially inconsistent national policy.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is essential in my judgment that a comprehensive study and review be made of all existing water resources legislation and policies and that recommendations be made in the full knowledge of national needs and objectives.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Because of the complex nature of the problems involved, they should have the most careful study before this project is authorized, in order to make sure that the policies established for this one project are indeed equitable and form a desirable precedent for future work of a similar nature.
shared_material.explanation: The child generalizes C20's call for careful advance study of water-policy implications into a comprehensive national review.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is my hope, therefore, that it will be possible for the Commission to submit interim recommendations to me on some of the more urgent issues which have been raised in order that specific proposals can be submitted to the Congress in time for action this year.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am having the various policy questions investigated further within the Executive Branch, and expect to submit fully considered recommendations to the next session of the Congress.
shared_material.explanation: Both use Executive Branch investigation of water-policy questions as the basis for later legislative recommendations to Congress.
